title: Synergistic catalysis of ionic liquid-modified ceria and silver-deposited activated carbon for the rapid and sensitive colorimetric detection of hydrogen peroxide
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48236-48246
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06434A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Asad, Mohibullah Shah, Naeem Khan, Anwar Iqbal, Khaled Fahmi Fawy, Xiaoping Zhang, Wei Sun, Amir Badshah, Umar Nishan
A unique combination of the IL-Ag-CeO2@AC nanocomposite achieves the colorimetric sensing of hydrogen peroxide with outstanding sensitivity and selectivity. The nanozyme demonstrates excellent peroxidase-mimicking activity.
